_about: What the extraction model reads. enabled=true: only the snippets found by the official keyword list (data/Stichwortliste.json), spoken digit sequences and the cue words in config/snippets/<cues>; false: the whole call, as before. Editable without code; a change produces a new extraction on the next pipeline run (cached separately).
_cues_note: cues_general.json is frozen and scenario-free; cues_tuned.json was tuned on the test calls and overfits. Empty string = keywords and digits only.
_if_no_snippets_note: full_transcript (default, safe): a call where no finder fires is read in full, so it can never be dismissed unseen. skip_model: no model call, the call becomes no_alert.
